description: Advance a physical order's ship_status and (when shipping) record the courier + tracking number. Owner-only. status must be one of pending|in_production|shipped|delivered.

notify.description: When status=shipped, email the customer a shipped + tracking notice (default false). Transactional shipping mail to the buyer of THIS order.

name: mu_ship_mark
title: Update an order's shipping status (owner only)
